header.running_head: Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Ali (RA) Distribute Everything in the Baytul Maal

blocks.text: tribulation. Should I disobey Allaah in a year for fear of something that may come during the next year? I have prepared Taqwa as a defence for the Muslims. Allaah mentions:

blocks.arabic_text: وَمَنْ يَّتَّقِ اللّٰهَ يَجْعَلْ لَّهٗ مَخْرَجًا ۙ وَّيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
blocks.text: Allaah shall create an escape (from difficulties) for the one who fears (disobeying) Allaah (one who has Taqwa) and shall provide for him (what he requires) from sources that he never expected (to receive provisions from).
However, the words of Shaytaan will soon become a test for those coming after me."[^1]
The Letter Hadhrat Umar (RA) Wrote to Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA)

Hadhrat Hasan narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) wrote the following letter to Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA):
I wish that there comes a day in the year when here remains not a single Dirham in the Baytul Maal and it is empty of everything so that Allaah may know that I have given every person his right.[^2]
The Letter of Hadhrat Umar (RA) to Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA)

Hadhrat Hasan also reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) wrote to Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) that he must give every person his dues and specified allowances. Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) wrote back saying that a large sum of money still remained after he had done so. Hadhrat Umar (RA) replied with a letter stating, "These are the spoils of the people that neither belongs to Umar nor to his family. Distribute it amongst the people."[^3]
Hadhrat Ali (RA) Distributes all the Wealth

Hadhrat Ali bin Rabee'ah Waalibi reports that Ibn Nabbaaj once came to Hadhrat Ali (RA) and said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! The Baytul Maal of the Muslims is full of gold and silver." Hadhrat Ali (RA) exclaimed, "Allaahu Akbar!" and then stood up with the support of Ibn Nabbaaj. Standing by the Baytul Mall, Hadhrat Ali (RA) recited the following couplet (which means):
"These are the fruits ready for picking and the best of it is still here (I have taken none of it)
Whereas the picker usually has his hand to his mouth (ready to consume the fruit)"
He then continued, "O Ibn Nabbaaj! Bring the people of Kufa here." When an announcement was made (and the people arrived), Hadhrat Ali (RA) distributed everything that lay in the Baytul Maal. As he distributed, he said, "O gold and O
